notes: Scored 12 first-round concerns (C1-C7, C12, C14, C15, C18, C19); C8, C9, C16 (novelty/significance) and C10, C11, C13, C17 (presentation) excluded. Review B also covers C8, C9 and C16 at length (missing NbSe2 metastable-vortex literature, overstated applications), but these are not scored. fixed_in_v1 follows the paper text: v1 already has the Joule-heating paragraphs with SI temperature traces (C1) and the 'We propose ... two different vortex species' picture (C15); both reviews still raised C1, arguing the v1 fix is insufficient. C19 marked partly for both because each raises pulse heating but neither names non-equilibrium quasiparticles. Neither review raised phase-slip centres (C2). Review A is narrower and centred on vortex-matter and heating lookalikes; Review B is a full referee report and matches more concerns, especially on the model and speculation (C5, C7, C12, C18).
